SELECT 
  "Block", 
  COUNT(*) AS "Overdue Loans", 
  COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(TOTAL."Total Loans", 0) AS "Percent Overdue"
FROM 
  shg_loan_register
JOIN 
  (SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) AS "Total Loans" FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY "Block") TOTAL
ON 
  shg_loan_register."Block" = TOTAL."Block"
WHERE 
  "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue'
GROUP BY 
  "Block"
ORDER BY 
  "Percent Overdue" DESC;
